settings.name: USE_SECURITYTXT
settings.description: **Enable Security.txt:** Set to `yes` to enable the security.txt file.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_URI
settings.description: **Security.txt URI:** Indicates the URI where the security.txt file will be accessible.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_CONTACT
settings.description: **Contact Information:** How security researchers can contact you (e.g., `mailto:security@example.com`).

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_EXPIRES
settings.description: **Expiration Date:** When this security.txt file should be considered expired (ISO 8601 format).

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_ENCRYPTION
settings.description: **Encryption:** URL pointing to encryption keys to be used for secure communication.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS
settings.description: **Acknowledgements:** URL where security researchers are recognized for their reports.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_POLICY
settings.description: **Security Policy:** URL pointing to the security policy describing how to report vulnerabilities.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_HIRING
settings.description: **Security Jobs:** URL pointing to security-related job openings.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_CANONICAL
settings.description: **Canonical URL:** The canonical URI(s) for this security.txt file.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_PREFERRED_LANG
settings.description: **Preferred Language:** The language(s) used in communications. Specified as an ISO 639-1 language code.

settings.name: SECURITYTXT_CSAF
settings.description: **CSAF:** Link to the provider-metadata.json of your Common Security Advisory Framework provider.
